description: This PHP file is part of the TestLink project and handles importing keywords from uploaded files. It initializes the import page, processes file uploads, manages different serialization import types (CSV and XML), and defines functions for argument parsing and GUI initialization.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, used here to import keywords and get project info.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: Handles the supported serialization formats and description for keywords.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for displaying the page.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates input arguments, determines the import type, and prepares the destination filepath.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI parameters based on arguments, including language strings and import options.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has modification rights for keywords on the project.
